assetIn.description: In case of buying some asset, this is the asset received.

assetAmountIn.description: In case of buying some asset, this is the number of assets received.

assetValueIn.description: In case of buying some asset, this is the value of assets in the default currency.

assetOut.description: In case of selling some asset, this is the asset traded out.

assetAmountOut.description: In case of selling some asset, this is the number of assets given.

assetValueOut.description: In case of selling some asset, this is the value of assets in the default currency.

fee.description: Amount of fee charged as a part of the transaction.

feeAsset.description: Ticker of the fee charged as a currency or other asset ticker.

taxType.description: If tax must be calculated, this is the type of the tax.

taxAmount.description: If tax must be calculated, this is the amount of tax in tax assets.

taxAsset.description: If tax must be calculated, this is the asset used (defaults to `valueAsset`)

taxPercentage.description: If tax must be calculated, alternatively it can be percentage of the total of the transaction.

value.description: Total value of the transaction, if known.

valueAsset.description: Asset used to determine the total value of the transaction.

rates.description: Conversion rates for assets involved, if known.
